gloss: to go bald; to lose hair; to become bare

definitions.gloss: to go bald; to lose hair
definitions.explanation: To lose hair from the head, resulting in baldness. Can describe gradual thinning or complete hair loss.

definitions.gloss: to become bare; to wear off; to peel
definitions.explanation: For surfaces like mountains, paint, or coatings to become stripped or bare, losing their covering.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{禿|は}げて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father was bald from a young age.

examples.english: I'm so stressed I feel like I'm going to go bald.

notes:
An ichidan (⟦{一段|いちだん}→一段：08951_ichidan⟧) verb. Also written without kanji as はげる. The kanji {禿|は}げ can be sensitive as a noun referring to a bald person — use with care in conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げる: to go bald
- ⟦ペンキ→ペンキ：00342_penki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げる: paint peels off
- ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{禿|は}げる: a mountain becomes bare
- {禿|は}げ{上|あ}がる: to go completely bald (intensive)

RELATED WORDS:
- {禿|は}げ: bald; bald person (noun) — can be considered rude
- ⟦{薄毛|うすげ}→薄毛：20459_usuge⟧: thinning hair — a more polite, euphemistic term
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair loss; hair removal — clinical/medical term
- ⟦{剥|は}がれる→剥がれる：04363_hagareru⟧: to peel off, come off — used for labels, stickers, surfaces
